title: H2 binned-render unified AXI host, VM ownership and safe reset
current_stage_ppa_policy: Synthesis only; no new place/route runs.
scope: Opt-in production host integration for GBJ1. H0-H8 functional and product closure remains incomplete.

source_changes_after_primary_run.explanation: One additional end-to-end DMA fixture is qualified separately. All 476 prior files, including all main RTL, build.sbt, driver ABI and primary fixtures, remain byte-identical.

discovery.compatibility: Reserved discovery word is readable zero on legacy profiles. New record is read-only; writes fail SLVERR. No old capability bit is repurposed; no old single-tile command is advertised as GBJ1.

command.pattern: Exclusive limit bit 32 in bit 0, remaining bits zero
command.completion: Unified command ID, opcode, success and 0..12 status. bytesProcessed counts requested padded append-line bytes, including faults, excluding the 512-byte descriptor.

host_contract.ordering: Binned work waits for prior nonkernel system work and legacy DMA acknowledgements. Unified memory/DMA operations wait for bin completion; compute may overlap in the pinned VM. Legacy fill/blit/strided kicks reject while a bin command is pending or active.
host_contract.vm_ownership: Vector/instruction SATP and flush remain protected through queued commands, renderer ownership, translator local faults, external accepted requests/replies, stalled adapter results and retained software completions.
host_contract.reset: Cancel renderer; retain offered/accepted descriptor, staging, attachment and completion ownership until drained. Late memory faults drain; reset discards old-epoch completions and queued commands. Safe ACK only after combined host/system/graphics drain.
host_contract.legacy_control: Legacy DMA, scanout and IRQ register control is retained. New bin work uses unified STATUS/COMPLETION; legacy STATUS and old fragment/OM/texture counters are not GBJ counters.
host_contract.driver_scope: gpu_abi.h declarations only; no kernel or userspace driver implementation.

translated_fabric.behavior: Separate translators for legacy DMA, root engine and each shader-staging client; disjoint data/walker ranges, registered request queue, selected-range response ready, drained includes upper replies/local faults.
translated_fabric.counters: DMA, root bin/descriptor, stage 0 and sum of remaining stage translation stall/miss/walk cycles.

functional.image_coverage: Two memory submissions per profile, bare then remapped Sv32, each 18 references/two batches/one restart; queued DMA waits for all attachment exports, stable software completion and VM locks. Peak shader CU ownership equals the two/four-CU pool.
functional.oracle: Complete sample words match separate unbinned RTL sharing raster/arithmetic/pixel implementation; not an independent API oracle.
functional.fault_coverage: Seven fresh-VM scenarios: obsolete descriptor length, invalid flags, old unified render opcode, descriptor bus fault, append bus fault, shader trap, healthy reuse. A real cease-only unified compute command also completes.
functional.reset_coverage: Descriptor AR then late fault; attachment W then late B fault; queued DMA abort, no old completion leak, VM exclusion until reset ACK, healthy reuse.
functional.legacy_coverage: Actual Sv32 legacy fill, blit and strided copy, exact physical output; a queued bin cannot fetch descriptors before the preceding legacy fill B acknowledgement.
functional.reduced_geometry: Native host image regressions use eight L2 sets and two ways; the separately emitted default profile uses 512 sets/four ways (128 KiB). Four-CU lane/warp dimensions are production-sized in one native case.
